name: Jesús Ramírez Nava
focus: Custom software · AI adoption · Testing & QA · Web
positioning: I build the software your business needs — custom apps, AI that saves real hours, websites that bring in clients, and testing that catches problems before your customers do. Built on ten years of C++ and Python engineering.
bio: Software engineer with 10 years of C++ and Python, now helping businesses and teams build, adopt, and test the software they run on. I've written firmware and CAN bus tooling at John Deere, ported a major streaming app to Amazon Fire TV, built test automation for release pipelines, and led teams of 10+ engineers. Today I build custom web and AI products for clients — like a leadership-coaching platform with AI-assisted evaluation — and real-time apps that make gatherings and events run smoother. Based in Monterrey (UTC-6), working remotely with clients in US and LATAM time zones.
